title: Auditing: who changed what, when and why

videos.script: Something is running in production. Who decided that, and why? No single system knows. Git knows who wrote the change and who approved it. Flux knows when it was applied. The API server knows every request it served, and Vault knows every secret it handed out. {{records}} This lesson reads all four. Flux learns to report back to Gitea, so a commit says where it was deployed. A second, small cluster shows the API server's audit log, and Vault's audit device records who read production's token, without writing the token down. {{logs}} Then one change, followed back from the running pod to the person who approved it. And the last step of the course: Vault's root token, revoked. {{trace}}
